cause: Sampler validates request.json then opens outputs and immediately reads status.json. Guardian creates request first but writes initial status only after campaign/GPU admission checks. Header creation precedes initial admission snapshot by2.1295seconds, consistent with first-read FileNotFoundError. No captured exception log proves the exact historical exception.
minimum_remedy: Catch FileNotFoundError for status.json, record a waiting event, continue bounded sampling or wait briefly for initial status.
Record query timeout/failure and JSON decode errors in a separate diagnostics JSONL and stderr, with explicit terminal summary.
Use a new telemetry version/path or output prefix. Preserve existing header-only and empty historical files.
Validate selected device UUID from request, collect device counters and process memory separately, and capture observation times and query durations.

Do not attribute device-wide utilization, power or memory to the owned profile on a shared GPU. Join telemetry by stage wall-clock intervals and identify profile PID/start ticks for process accounting.
scope: Read-only inspection and two successful nvidia-smi metadata queries; no helper modifications, sampler launches, worker changes or GPU computation.
